comments.author: dasil003
comments.story: The early 90s tech scene that created L0pht, the legendary hackerspace
comments.why: Example of strong retro computing nostalgia
comments.text: As a teenager at the time, there was a palpable feeling of being part of a counter-culture that was on the bleeding edge of an inevitable future which adults simply could not grok. That world definitely ain't coming back, in large part because global internet connectivity has rendered quaint the very notion of counter-culture. On the other hand, retro computing and nostalgia for the era has never been stronger or more accessible: [VIDEO]
